title: Delivery-Claim Record and Investigation Holds on Replaced Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
When a locked Gift Cards & Store Credit card is replaced, the investigation hold share is adjusted by the holder's delivery-claim record, that is, by how many times compensation was issued on any of the holder's Delivery Claims in the last 12 months.

```
Compensation issued in the last 12 months
        |
        |-- never ...................... share lowered by 0.05
        |-- exactly once ............... share not adjusted
        '-- two or more times .......... share raised by 0.20

The adjusted share is never below zero.
```

The record counts each issue of compensation on the holder's delivery claims dated fewer than 12 whole months before the replacement date. The adjustment applies to every replacement, including one whose investigation hold share is nothing.

## Worked shares (hypothetical shares before adjustment)

| Share before adjustment | Record in the window | Adjusted share |
|---|---|---|
| 0.30 | None | 0.25 |
| 0.30 | Once | 0.30 |
| 0.30 | Twice | 0.50 |
| Nothing | None | Nothing (never below zero) |
| Nothing | Three times | 0.20 |
| 0.03 | None | Nothing (lowering by 0.05 stops at zero) |
